assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an ORIGINAL onboarding illustration asset for a Korean shift-work app. The attached reference screenshot is ONLY a STYLE REFERENCE: imitate the approachable simple rounded 3D human illustration's material, scale and calm mood, not the screenshot, not any text or brand. Output a SINGLE isolated illustration on a truly TRANSPARENT background. No screen/UI, no lettering, no watermark, no branded logo. Square canvas, composition fills about 82%, keep all items within frame. A friendly adult woman with simple smooth short dark brown side-parted bob, warm light peach face, tiny black oval eyes, small smiling open mouth, white/ivory blouse. Waist-up front 3/4 view, calm minimal toy-like 3D geometry, satin matte smooth plastic, no detailed hair strands, no cloth texture, no exaggerated Pixar facial detail. Soft diffuse frontal studio lighting, subtle shading, bright cream white with a strong blue accent and a little muted teal. A simple practical work item in her hands and one small rounded floating bubble by upper right. No elaborate decoration or multiple characters; no floor or background shadow. The woman should occupy the center, the blue work item lower left, clear silhouette legible at 220px. Subject: She holds a clean white desktop calendar with blue binding/header. Calendar has a very simple 2x3 grid of pale cells with ONE blue checked date, no numbers. A small blue rounded calendar symbol sits lower left in foreground. The upper-right white-gray softly inflated speech bubble contains a single blue checkmark. Friendly first day at work, no currency symbol.
